main.job: you, plural, for friends and strangers alike
main.why: Finishes the 'you' set started by tú and usted; Latin America has no vosotros.
The go job is uncovered: only the ir a + infinitivo future pattern is known.
Finishes the modal set (querer, poder, tener que known).

main.job: nobody / not anybody, with double negation
main.why: Negative-word set started by no … nada.
Unlocks giving reasons and purposes in one clause.
The come job is uncovered; pairs with ir.
Negative-word set started by no … nada.
Core discourse glue for explaining yourself.

main.job: know a fact or know how to do something
main.why: Top-frequency verb; half of the saber/conocer pair.
Very frequent way to talk about the just-happened past without tense choices.

main.job: no / none (not one), with double negation
main.why: Negative-word set started by no … nada; ningún problema is everyday.

main.job: know a person or a place, be familiar with
main.why: Other half of the saber/conocer pair.

spares.job: ago: how long since something happened
spares.why: Hace dos años: the everyday way to say 'ago'.

spares.job: so / then, moving the talk forward

shape.notes: Repeat request: moves forward from the earlier glossary. Started sets finished (you, modals, negative words). Question words (qué, dónde, cuándo, cómo, quién, cuánto, cuál, por qué) are an 8-member A1 set treated as already mastered at A2–B1 and not started. estar + gerundio left out because excluded estar is lemma-scope.
